mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, tenant_name, status, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, timezone, created_at, updated_at FROM tenant WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant SET tenant_code = #{in.tenantCode}, tenant_name = #{in.tenantName}, status = 'ACTIVE', contact_name = #{in.contactName}, contact_phone = #{in.contactPhone}, contact_email = #{in.contactEmail}, timezone = #{in.timezone}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
